The '''Taurannik Codex''' was an ancient tome<ref name="SM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> that had once fallen into the hands of the death cult known as the [[Knell of Muspilli]], based in the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The cultists transcribed the Codex in an attempt to summon apocalyptic [[Deity/Legends|deities]] from [[Beyond shadows|beyond]] the Gap's spatial fissure.<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> However, around [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], the tome was destroyed during the [[Muurshantre Extinction]] and was long considered lost.<ref name="SM" />

A hundred [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, during the era of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] explored the Unknown Regions in search of knowledge that might grant him unlimited power. Within the Gunninga Gap, he wandered among drifting [[moon tree]]s until he discovered the remaining scraps of the Codex. Arcane hints preserved within that forbidden text eventually led him to the ruins of a colossal [[Temple of Korman Lao|temple]]<ref name="SM" /> near the [[Valtaullu Rift/Legends|Valtaullu Rift]].<ref name="UR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', certain [[Taurannix chapbooks]] were mentioned. It remained unclear whether any connection existed between the objects, or if the word «Taurannix» had simply been a misspelling of «Taurannik».
